new.title: Find the frescoes of El Nazar Church near Göreme
new.desc: El Nazar Church (Church of the Evil Eye) is a rock-cut church of about the 10th century, standing near the start of the Zemi Valley trail. Its restored frescoes and carved interior are among the finest outside the Open-Air Museum.
new.tip: Quiet early in the morning or late afternoon; it is a short walk from the museum road and has a small entrance fee.
new.q: El Nazar Kilisesi, Zemi Vadisi, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Explore the courtyard of Hallaç Monastery in Ortahisar
new.desc: Hallaç Monastery is a large rock-cut complex north-east of Ortahisar with a three-sided courtyard, big halls and a spacious cave church, carved in one campaign in the 11th century. Its original purpose is still debated.
new.tip: Walk up from Ortahisar village; bring a torch for the dark halls.
new.q: Hallaç Manastırı, Ortahisar, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: See the carved Altıkapılı Türbe in Ürgüp
new.desc: The Altıkapılı Tomb in Ürgüp is a Seljuk-period tomb known for its carved stonework. It stands in the town and is easy to combine with a walk through old Ürgüp.
new.tip: Open in daytime hours; free to look at from outside.
new.q: Altıkapılı Türbe, Ürgüp Merkez, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Photograph the Üç Güzeller fairy chimneys
new.desc: Üç Güzeller, the Three Beauties, are three tall tuff fairy chimneys beside the road between Ürgüp and Göreme, with a small one standing between two big ones. They are among the most photographed formations in Cappadocia.
new.tip: Free to visit; best in morning light with a tea from the roadside stalls.
new.q: Üç Güzeller Peribacaları, Ürgüp-Göreme yolu, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Climb up to the rock churches of Sarıca Valley
new.desc: Sarıca Church sits in the Kepez Valley near Ürgüp, with churches carved into isolated volcanic cones in an open valley. The site is unattended and free; church 3 has been restored but stays locked.
new.tip: Wear good shoes for the short scramble and go in daylight.
new.q: Sarıca Kilisesi, Kepez Vadisi, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Wander the cave monastery of Keşlik
new.desc: Keşlik Monastery is a rock-cut monastic complex near Cemilköy and Mustafapaşa with two churches (St Michael and St Stephen), a large refectory hall and a sacred spring. It was in use until the 1924 population exchange.
new.tip: Reach it by a short track off the Mustafapaşa road; a torch helps inside.
new.q: Keşlik Manastırı, Cemilköy, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Admire the portal of the Taşkınpaşa Madrasa
new.desc: The Taşkınpaşa complex dates to the Karamanid period around 1350 and is known for the tall carved portal of its madrasa. Two Seljuk-era tombs stand beside the mosque in the village.
new.tip: On the Ürgüp to Soğanlı road, so pair it with a Soğanlı visit; the mosque is usually closed.
new.q: Taşkınpaşa Medresesi, Taşkınpaşa Köyü, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Dig into Sobesos, Cappadocia's Roman city
new.desc: Sobesos, found in 2002 near Şahinefendi village, is the only ancient Roman city identified so far in Cappadocia, with a Byzantine layer of about the sixth century. Excavations are still going on.
new.tip: Check access with the local museum first as excavation areas can be closed.
new.q: Sobesos Antik Kenti, Şahinefendi, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Meet the Hittite finds of Kayseri Archaeology Museum
new.desc: Open since 1969, Kayseri Archaeology Museum shows finds from prehistory to the Ottoman era, including material from nearby Kültepe-Kaniş. It sits beside the citadel in the old centre.
new.tip: Check opening hours before going as sources differ.
new.q: Kayseri Arkeoloji Müzesi, Kümeevler, Melikgazi, Kayseri

new.title: See the Hacı Kılıç Mosque and Madrasa complex
new.desc: Hacı Kılıç Mosque and Madrasa are historic buildings in central Kayseri listed in the provincial tourism inventory. They show the city's tradition of black volcanic stonework.
new.tip: Free to look at from outside; combine with the citadel area.
new.q: Hacı Kılıç Camii, Melikgazi, Kayseri

new.title: Find Köşk Medrese in the old centre of Kayseri
new.desc: Köşk Medrese is a historic madrasa in Kayseri's core, listed in the provincial tourism inventory near the citadel and Hunat Hatun area.
new.tip: Easy to include on a walk between the citadel and Cumhuriyet Square.
new.q: Köşk Medrese, Melikgazi, Kayseri

new.title: Look up at the stars of Cacabey Madrasa in Kırşehir
new.desc: Cacabey Madrasa was completed in 1272-73 for the governor Nureddin Cibril bin Caca Bey and is known as an early centre of astronomy teaching with an observatory. It was restored by 2023 and is used as a mosque.
new.tip: Visit together with the nearby Ahi Evran complex.
new.q: Cacabey Medresesi, Kırşehir Merkez, Kırşehir

new.title: Study the carvings of Hüdavent Hatun Tomb in Niğde
new.desc: Hüdavent Hatun Tomb was built in 1312 for the daughter of the Seljuk sultan Kilij Arslan IV. It is famous for its rich vegetal and animal reliefs.
new.tip: Free and quick to see; combine with the other Niğde Seljuk monuments.
new.q: Hüdavent Hatun Türbesi, Niğde Merkez, Niğde

new.title: Dine on the terrace of Elai under Uçhisar Castle
new.desc: Elai began as a village café and is now one of Cappadocia's most praised restaurants, with white tablecloths and a terrace below Uçhisar Castle looking over Pigeon and Rose valleys.
new.tip: Book a table for sunset; try the Anatolian lamb dishes.
new.q: Elai Restaurant, Uçhisar, Nevşehir

new.title: Break a clay pot of testi kebab at Antep Sofrası in Ürgüp
new.desc: Ürgüp Antep Sofrası Testi Kebap & Pide is a grill known for testi kebab, the meat-and-vegetable stew cooked in a sealed clay jug that is cracked open at the table.
new.tip: Order the testi kebab ahead if you can; it is open late.
new.q: Ürgüp Antep Sofrası Testi Kebap & Pide, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Eat slow-cooked tandır lamb at Tandır House in Ürgüp
new.desc: Tandır House Restaurant in Ürgüp's Dereler quarter is built around tandır dishes, lamb cooked slowly in a pit oven until it falls from the bone.
new.tip: Go for dinner and ask for the tandır with rice.
new.q: Tandır House Restaurant, Dereler Sokak 18, Dereler, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Dine in a cave at Hezen Restaurant in Ortahisar
new.desc: Hezen Restaurant in Ortahisar serves Central Anatolian cooking in a cave-carved dining room below the castle.
new.tip: Book ahead in season; the cave room is the best seat.
new.q: Hezen Restaurant, Tahirbey Sokak, Esentepe, Ortahisar, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Taste the village cooking of Babayan Evi in Ortahisar
new.desc: Babayan Evi Restaurant is listed in the Michelin Guide, serving regional Cappadocian dishes in a restored stone house in the Ortahisar quarter.
new.tip: Reserve for dinner and ask for the seasonal local dishes.
new.q: Babayan Evi Restaurant, Ortahisar, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Have a Turkish breakfast at Görkündere Cafe in Göreme
new.desc: Görkündere Cafe Breakfast, a short walk from the main street, serves a spread of Turkish breakfast with organic produce, on a terrace facing the fairy chimneys.
new.tip: Come before 10:30 for the full spread; service can be slow.
new.q: Görkündere Cafe Breakfast, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Start the day at Cafe Şafak in Göreme
new.desc: Cafe Şafak is a popular breakfast and coffee stop in Göreme, known for Turkish omelette, çılbır eggs, lentil soup and daily specials.
new.tip: Try the çılbır at breakfast or the soup at lunch.
new.q: Cafe Şafak, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Eat a village breakfast at Karşı Bucak in Göreme
new.desc: Karşı Bucak Kahvaltı Cafe is a Turkish breakfast place with many small plates and a view, set a little off the main streets.
new.tip: Reviewers mention a low price per person; arrive in the morning.
new.q: Karşı Bucak Kahvaltı Cafe, Karamızrak Sokak, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Enjoy the buffet breakfast at Maria's in Göreme
new.desc: Maria's Breakfast Göreme offers a Turkish buffet breakfast with Turkish coffee and views, a favourite for a slow start after the balloon flights.
new.tip: Prices are listed in lira per person; go early in high season.
new.q: Maria's Breakfast, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Watch Ürgüp from the terraces of Ziggy's Cafe
new.desc: Ziggy's Shoppe & Cafe in Ürgüp is known for three outdoor terraces with views over the old town, serving light meals and drinks.
new.tip: Choose a terrace table at sunset.
new.q: Ziggy's Shoppe & Cafe, Tevfik Fikret Caddesi No:24, Yunak Mahallesi, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Taste tiny Kayseri mantı at Kaşıkla
new.desc: Kaşıkla serves Kayseri mantı, the dumplings so small that about 40 fit on one spoon, finished with garlic yogurt and hot butter-and-paprika sauce.
new.tip: Order the classic mantı with sumac and chili butter.
new.q: Kaşıkla Mantı, Kayseri

new.title: Eat a crisp Develi cıvıklısı at Lezzet Develi Cıvıklısı
new.desc: Cıvıklı is the thin Develi flatbread topped with minced meat, a Kayseri breakfast staple, baked fresh at this well-regarded bakery in the city.
new.tip: Eat it hot at breakfast with ayran.
new.q: Lezzet Develi Cıvıklısı, Tuna Caddesi No:12/B, Erciyesevler, Kocasinan, Kayseri

new.title: Try çullama and madımak at Ağalar Konağı in Kırşehir
new.desc: Ağalar Konağı is a Kırşehir restaurant recommended for local dishes such as çullama, a labour-intensive guest and wedding dish, and madımak.
new.tip: Ask for the çullama and keşkef.
new.q: Ağalar Konağı, Kırşehir Merkez, Kırşehir

new.title: Eat the house meat at Kardeşler Restoran in Aksaray
new.desc: Kardeşler Restoran in Aksaray city is a large Michelin Guide listed restaurant where meat is the house speciality.
new.tip: Good lunch stop between Ihlara and Sultanhanı.
new.q: Kardeşler Restoran, Aksaray Merkez, Aksaray

new.title: Hike the Zemi Valley loop from Göreme
new.desc: Zemi Valley is a roughly 6 km loop of 2-3 hours starting between the Open-Air Museum and the Tourist Hotel, through tuff canyons and past El Nazar Church. It can finish on the Nevşehir-Ürgüp road near Uçhisar.
new.tip: Start early to avoid crowds and carry water.
new.q: Zemi Vadisi, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Walk the Meskendir Valley to Red and Rose valleys
new.desc: Meskendir is the valley between Göreme and Red Valley, signposted towards El Nazar Church. It is the start of the Göreme, Meskendir, Red, Rose and Sword valley loop.
new.tip: Follow the signs south up the valley; allow 3-4 hours for the full loop.
new.q: Meskendir Vadisi, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Hike Sword Valley (Kılıçlar Vadisi) above Göreme
new.desc: Sword Valley is a short route of about 3 km and one hour, named for its sword-like rocks. The trailhead is just up the Ortahisar road from the Open-Air Museum, in a protected area.
new.tip: Combine it with Rose and Red valleys for a 13 km loop.
new.q: Kılıçlar Vadisi, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Watch sunset from Aktepe Hill over Kızılçukur
new.desc: Aktepe Hill is a popular sunset spot in Cappadocia, looking over the russet folds of Kızılçukur Valley.
new.tip: Arrive early to get a spot; it fills up at sunset.
new.q: Aktepe Gün Batımı Noktası, Göreme Tarihi Milli Parkı, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Watch a whirling dervish Sema in Saruhan Caravanserai
new.desc: The 13th-century Saruhan caravanserai near Avanos on the Kızılırmak is the main venue for the nightly Mevlevi Sema ceremony of the whirling dervishes, about 45 minutes long.
new.tip: Doors open around 6:30 pm; filming is usually only allowed in the last minutes.
new.q: Saruhan Kervansarayı, Avanos, Nevşehir

new.title: Browse small-winery wines at Mahzen Şarap Evi
new.desc: Mahzen Şarap Evi is a small family-run wine house tucked behind Ürgüp's old hammam, gathering bottles from small Cappadocian producers: dry, medium-dry and sweet wines plus fruit wines. It is a short walk from Efendi Wine House.
new.tip: Tasting policy varies, so ask before sitting down; combine with a stroll through old Ürgüp.
new.q: Mahzen Şarap Evi, İstiklal Caddesi No:22, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Taste Cappadocian wines at Ailanpa Wine House
new.desc: Ailanpa Wine House is an Ürgüp wine bar listed by Lonely Planet where local boutique wines are poured by the glass.
new.tip: Go in the evening and ask for a tasting flight.
new.q: Ailanpa Şarap Evi, Ürgüp, Nevşehir

new.title: Sip wine with a valley view at Salkım Şarap Evi in Avanos
new.desc: Salkım Şarap Evi on Edip Akbayram Sokak in Avanos is a cosy wine bar with a terrace over the valleys, pairing local wines with cheese and snacks.
new.tip: Choose a terrace table at sunset.
new.q: Salkım Şarap Evi, Edip Akbayram Sokak, Avanos, Nevşehir

new.title: Steam and scrub at Elis Hamam in Göreme
new.desc: Elis Hamam on Belediye Caddesi is a Turkish bath with marble halls, sauna and foam massage, used as a meeting point for Cappadocia hammam packages.
new.tip: Packages run one to two hours; check whether transfers are included.
new.q: Elis Hamam, Belediye Caddesi, Göreme, Nevşehir

new.title: Walk the rim of the crater lake Narlıgöl
new.desc: Narlıgöl is a crater lake on the Aksaray-Niğde border near Güzelyurt, with a warm spring near the shore and thermal facilities being developed.
new.tip: Combine with Ihlara or Güzelyurt.
new.q: Narlıgöl, Güzelyurt, Aksaray

new.title: Watch flamingos and salt flats at Tuz Gölü near Aksaray
new.desc: Tuz Gölü is Turkey's second-largest lake, about 57 km north-west of Aksaray, producing around 40 percent of the country's salt, with flamingos and sunset colours.
new.tip: Best in summer when the shore is dry and white; avoid mid-day heat.
new.q: Tuz Gölü, Eskil, Aksaray

new.title: Fly a tandem paraglide off Ali Dağı near Kayseri
new.desc: Ali Dağı in Talas, 15 minutes from Kayseri, is an established paragliding site that hosted the 2004 World Paragliding Championship and offers tandem flights.
new.tip: Check the wind and book with a local club.
new.q: Ali Dağı Yamaç Paraşütü Alanı, Talas, Kayseri

new.title: Stroll through Kıranardı City Forest in Kayseri
new.desc: Kıranardı Kent Ormanı is a city forest in Kayseri used for picnics, jogging and light walks.
new.tip: Good for a morning walk away from the old centre.
new.q: Kıranardı Kent Ormanı, Yayla Yolu Caddesi, Melikgazi, Kayseri
